name: Lyrica Merung
source: Lyrica is an adult woman with magnificent breasts who loves to drink alcohol at the bar and teasing men, especially Caro. She became a participant of this dangerous adventure, hoping to meet more demons. Something terrible happened In the Lyrica's past, that made her hate the demons. Since that time, she fanatically hunts them, unable to quench her thirst for revenge. For this purpose she uses the power of a controlled spirit, and to strengthen it, Lyrica sucks the blood of defeated demons through her dagger. But what awaits her on the path of revenge? If there is someone who would help her to abandon this course?
